title: Four Camunda-cohort leads carry an unverified Camunda partnership that must be confirmed before pitching
content:
The flag is short and operational: the Camunda partnership is not verified for these leads, and it should be confirmed before pitching. Four leads carry it — Consileon, Creetion and Senacor Technologies in DE and x1F in NL — all at "3 · later".

It matters more than a typical data-quality caveat because the entire Camunda approach presupposes the relationship. The demo attaches to a Camunda job worker, the fit argument is about Camunda's mutable instance history, and the route into the account is the partner's existing Camunda practice. If the practice does not exist, none of that transfers; the lead would need re-researching from the tool column outward.

The flag is recoverable from the lead records themselves rather than only from this note: it is encoded twice, once in the source column ("v5 · Camunda cohort (unverified)") and once in the tool column ("Camunda (unverified)"). These same four leads are also part of the ten-lead group that carries the sovereign-procurability Camunda demo, so exactly 40% of that demo's audience rests on an unconfirmed premise. Creetion additionally appears in the Flowable partner cohort, which may make it reachable on a verified footing regardless.
